description: This PHP class 'MailerSubscriber' is an event subscriber for the OrangeHRM system that listens to kernel termination events. When triggered, it checks a cache item to determine if emails need to be sent, and if so, it utilizes the EmailQueueService to process all pending emails, logging the start, end, and execution time of this process.

classes.name: MailerSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that listens to kernel terminate events to trigger email sending via a queued approach, with caching, logging, and authentication traits integrated.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events the subscriber is listening to, specifically the kernel terminate event.

methods.name: onTerminateEvent
methods.description: Handles the terminate event. Checks cache to decide whether to process email queue; logs execution time and updates cache.
